# Best self-hosted ChatGPT alternatives (2026) | SelfHostAI

Source: https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/best-self-hosted-chatgpt-alternatives.html
Last updated: 2026-10-15


**Short answer:** The most common self-hosted ChatGPT alternative is Ollama (to run models) plus Open WebUI (the chat interface); LibreChat suits multi-provider setups, AnythingLLM chatting with documents, and Jan a desktop app with no server.

Last updated: 15 October 2026 · No tax figures on this site, so no GOV.UK check applies; tool details come from each project's public GitHub repository · [Markdown version](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/best-self-hosted-chatgpt-alternatives.html.md)

A self-hosted ChatGPT setup needs two parts: a **model runtime** and a **chat interface**.

| Tool | Type | Licence | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Open WebUI](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-open-webui.html) | Chat UI | BSD-3 | ChatGPT-style UI for Ollama and APIs |
| [LibreChat](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-librechat.html) | Chat UI | MIT | Multi-provider chat with agents |
| [AnythingLLM](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-anything-llm.html) | RAG app | MIT | Chat with your documents |
| [Jan](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-jan.html) | Desktop app | Apache-2.0 | Offline, no server |
| [Ollama](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-ollama.html) | Runtime | MIT | One-command local models |

## What does a typical self-hosted stack look like?

Laptop: Jan, or Ollama + Open WebUI. Small team on a VPS: Ollama or [vLLM](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-vllm.html) + LibreChat or Open WebUI, with [Langfuse](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-langfuse.html) for observability. See [Ollama vs llama.cpp vs vLLM](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/ollama-vs-llama-cpp-vs-vllm.html).

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the easiest self-hosted ChatGPT alternative?

For a single machine, Ollama to run models plus Open WebUI as the chat interface is the most common setup. Jan is a desktop app if you do not want Docker.

### Do I need a GPU?

Not for small quantised models: llama.cpp and Ollama can run them on CPU, but slowly. For larger models or several users, a GPU makes a big difference.

### Can I use cloud APIs from the same interface?

Yes. Open WebUI, LibreChat and AnythingLLM can connect to OpenAI-compatible APIs as well as local models.

# Ollama vs llama.cpp vs vLLM: which local LLM runtime? | SelfHostAI

Source: https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/ollama-vs-llama-cpp-vs-vllm.html
Last updated: 2026-10-15


**Short answer:** Use Ollama for the easiest local setup, llama.cpp for CPU, edge devices and fine control, and vLLM for high-throughput GPU serving to many users.

Last updated: 15 October 2026 · No tax figures on this site, so no GOV.UK check applies; tool details come from each project's public GitHub repository · [Markdown version](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/ollama-vs-llama-cpp-vs-vllm.html.md)

|  | [Ollama](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-ollama.html) | [llama.cpp](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-llama.cpp.html) | [vLLM](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-vllm.html) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best for | Easiest local setup | CPU, edge devices, full control | High-throughput GPU serving |
| Hardware | CPU or GPU | CPU or GPU | GPU |
| Licence | MIT | MIT | Apache-2.0 |
| Repo | [ollama/ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama) | [ggml-org/llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) | [vllm-project/vllm](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) |

Rule of thumb: start with Ollama, drop to llama.cpp when you need fine control or very low resources, and move to vLLM when many users hit one GPU server. [LocalAI](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-localai.html) is another OpenAI-compatible option. Add a UI from the [ChatGPT alternatives](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/best-self-hosted-chatgpt-alternatives.html) list.

## Frequently asked questions

### Should I use Ollama or llama.cpp?

Ollama is easier: one command to pull and run models, with an API. llama.cpp is the lower-level C/C++ engine, which gives more control and runs well on CPU.

### When should I use vLLM?

When you serve many concurrent requests on a GPU. vLLM is built for high-throughput serving rather than single-user desktop use.

### Do they offer an OpenAI-compatible API?

All three can expose an HTTP API that many OpenAI-compatible clients can use. Check each project's docs for the exact endpoints.


<!-- https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/open-webui-vs-librechat-vs-anythingllm.html -->
# Open WebUI vs LibreChat vs AnythingLLM (self-hosted chat UIs) | SelfHostAI

Source: https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/open-webui-vs-librechat-vs-anythingllm.html
Last updated: 2026-10-15


**Short answer:** Open WebUI is the usual ChatGPT-style UI for Ollama, LibreChat is best for mixing many API providers with agents, and AnythingLLM is built around chatting with your documents (RAG).

Last updated: 15 October 2026 · No tax figures on this site, so no GOV.UK check applies; tool details come from each project's public GitHub repository · [Markdown version](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/open-webui-vs-librechat-vs-anythingllm.html.md)

|  | [Open WebUI](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-open-webui.html) | [LibreChat](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-librechat.html) | [AnythingLLM](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-anything-llm.html) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Focus | ChatGPT-style UI, Ollama-friendly | Multi-provider chat + agents | All-in-one RAG over documents |
| Licence (as listed) | BSD-3 | MIT | MIT |
| Repo | [open-webui](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui) | [LibreChat](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat) | [anything-llm](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm) |

All three run in Docker on a modest VPS. The model runtime is the heavy part: see [runtimes compared](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/ollama-vs-llama-cpp-vs-vllm.html). For document search at scale add [Qdrant](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-qdrant.html).

## Frequently asked questions

### Open WebUI or LibreChat?

Open WebUI is the usual choice alongside Ollama for a polished single-team UI. LibreChat is strong when you mix many API providers and want agents.

### What about chatting with my documents?

AnythingLLM is built around RAG over your files. Open WebUI also offers document features. For a vector database, see Qdrant.

### Which is fully MIT licensed?

LibreChat and AnythingLLM are listed as MIT. Open WebUI is listed as BSD-3; check its repository for any branding terms.

# Flowise: self-hosting guide & alternatives | SelfHostAI

Source: https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-flowise.html
Last updated: 2026-10-15


**Short answer:** How to self-host Flowise: requirements, licence and alternatives.

Last updated: 15 October 2026 · No tax figures on this site, so no GOV.UK check applies; tool details come from each project's public GitHub repository · [Markdown version](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/tool-flowise.html.md)

Drag-and-drop LLM flows.

| Category | Agent builder |
|---|---|
| Licence | Apache-2.0 |
| Repo | [FlowiseAI/Flowise](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise) |

## How do you self-host it?

See the official README for Docker or binary install. A 2 vCPU / 4 GB VPS runs most UIs; LLM runtimes need a GPU or must run small quantised models on CPU.

## What are the alternatives?

Dify
